name: dsh-lite-balance
description: Lightweight DeepSeek balance display for the dsh web GUI: sidebar-footer chip + slimmed composer stats line (turns/steps, session tokens, balance, peak/off-peak) with status colors, auto/manual refresh, low-balance alert and one-click top-up. · 轻量余额显示器：侧边栏余额 chip + 精简统计条（轮次/步数、Token 用量、余额、高峰/低谷），状态变色、自动/手动刷新、低余额提醒、一键充值。
